title: Statement from UC Academic Senate Chair Ahmet Palazoglu on BOARS undergraduate admissions review
snippet: Today (July 22), the University of California's Academic Council directed the Board of Admissions and Relations with Schools (BOARS) to oversee a faculty-led, evidence-based review of the use of standardized testing in undergraduate admissions. The review will be conducted under an expedited schedule during the 2026–27 academic year.

title: AI Can Make Existing Inequalities Even Worse
snippet: In an article discussing how AI can exacerbate existing social and economic inequalities, UCLA professor and MacArthur Fellow Safiya Noble is quoted on the technology's dual potential: 'AI has the power to either bridge the gap or widen it, depending on how it is used and implemented.'

title: Divisional Chair's Newsletter July 2026
snippet: The Santa Barbara Division approved three new degree programs this year, which surely must be an institutional record. Courses for the B.S. in Artificial Intelligence, based in Computer Science, will begin in the coming academic year (UCSB and UC San Diego are the first UC campuses to offer the degree).
